summary: This Form 6-K filed by Etoiles Capital Group Co., Ltd. (the Company) on July 10, 2026 announces the resignation of independent director Qi Ding for personal reasons, with no dispute, and the appointment of Wesley Chu as an independent director, compensation committee chairman, and audit/nominating committee member. Chu, a U.S. citizen, receives HK$12,000 annual compensation. This appointment aligns with the Company’s prior disclosed plan to restructure the Board to have half U.S. members. The filing is a routine director change; no extraordinary event or special situation is present. What to watch: continued Board refreshment toward U.S. nexus.
